label: The target fact and the stance's accepted fact agree on the feature
paraphrase: P2 of the parity argument, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the target fact and the fact the stance accepts (in the naturalist instance, that God exists and that the contingent foundation exists) agree on the supplied feature k: both have it or both lack it. Whether they agree depends on k and on how each is posited: on the reason-status feature they agree when God is posited as brute and differ when God is posited with a reason by its own nature (parity map).
